item.title: Kansas House studies free-lunch enrollment audit, implications of at-risk overpayment to schools
item.description: TOPEKA — Members of the Kansas House Welfare Reform Committee debated Tuesday implications of a jarring state audit that estimated 54% to 72% of Kansas students who qualified for the free-lunch program through a national application process were likely ineligible during the 2023-2024 academic year.
